messages:
Avery: Starting a short thread to lock down publisher onboarding for the cloud storefront (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for: SKU naming, legal manifest, cross-account roles, and where to host publisher assets. Target staging request by EOW.
Jae: I can do SKU naming + bundle descriptions. Thinking 4 SKUs: dev, team, scale, enterprise-trial. Will post spreadsheet.
Noor: I'll own assets (logos, hero, screenshots) and the upload README. Where do we put them? Shared drive or direct into publisher portal?
Priya: Eng note: prefer shared drive first for review. Also will draft minimal IAM snippets for all clouds. Need an owner for terraform examples.
Avery: I'll take publisher workflow + manifest template. Will also set up the shared folder under /Shared/marketplace/onboards/1729998888.
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: Preflight checklist entry: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/checklists/publisher-onboard-v1.md
Jae: Proposed SKU IDs: RWD-DEV, RWD-TEAM, RWD-SCALE, RWD-PRO-TR. Note: Diego asked to avoid visible "ENT" label. Is RWD-PRO-TR ok?
Noor: RWD-PRO-TR works. Asset README: 1200x628 hero, 512x512 square logo, 300x300 alt icon. I'll include alt text + attribution fields.
Priya: AWS trust policy sample to include in the manifest:
```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodPublisher"}, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole" }] }
```
Avery: Legal: can you confirm required privacy docs and if we need a retention statement on the listing?
Avery: @Diego (cc) please weigh in.
marketplace-bot: :warning: Compliance reminder: upload signed privacy_manifest.pdf before staging publish.
Jae: Packaging note: include a short bullet list for each SKU + CTA mapping (trial -> Start free trial, paid -> Contact sales). I'll draft language by EOD.
Priya: For GCP the service account needs roles/storage.objectViewer + roles/compute.viewer. Azure needs Managed Identity with Reader + Storage Blob Data Reader. I'll write a tiny README for publisher infra.
Noor: I'll upload sample screenshots + README tonight. Share link when folder is ready.
Avery: Quick actions:
- Avery: create shared folder + manifest template (today)
- Jae: SKU spreadsheet + packaging copy (24h)
- Priya: cloud IAM snippets + terraform example (48h)
- Noor: asset pack + README (24h)
Avery: Can we meet for a 20-min handoff tomorrow 9:30 AM PT to sanity-check everything?
Jae: In.
Priya: Yes.
Noor: I'll be there.
Avery: I'll send invite and attach the preflight checklist. Thanks team :rocket:
